Create/Set reject oversized or unaligned payloads before copying, then check the owned snapshot through one structure/reflection/interface path; failed reload preserves the old program and Get returns a copy. This does not expose source text. Runtime checks cover structure and reflected interfaces, not all instruction semantics. Import/cache integration and further shader profiles remain pending.

CanvasTimingTests verifies replacement rather than accumulation, node-before-draw composition, invalid write rollback, hidden-interval skipping, per-frame identity reset and zero warmed replay allocations. CanvasTimingRenderingTests passes 12-frame Wayland compatibility/GPU HLSL/GLSL and dummy/software pixels; full matrix pixels also pass through CanvasPixelSnapRenderingTests on Wayland. Typed finite/recording errors follow ADR 0004; other platforms remain unverified.

Pinned CanvasItem get_transform is pure virtual; Electron2D CanvasItem exposes the same abstract local-transform role. Entity and Control production overrides return their local matrices with attached owner-thread guards; SceneHierarchyTests and ControlLayoutTests verify concrete values, custom CanvasItem derivation and off-owner rejection, with Wayland mixed-hierarchy pixels. A caller-defined override owns its own guard and math; other platforms remain unverified.

Pinned CanvasItem material setter stores a borrowed Resource and refreshes tooling properties on every assignment, including equal values. SceneHierarchyTests checks defaults, disposed-input rejection, readable externally disposed reference, committed state after callback failure, owner-thread reads, direct/neutral/TopLevel inheritance and PackedScene borrowing. CanvasMaterialRenderingTests verifies live Add/Sub/Mix paths on Linux Wayland compatibility/GPU; editor UI and other platforms remain separate.

Pinned Modulate multiplies along direct canvas ancestors and stops at neutral/TopLevel boundaries, without requiring command re-recording. SceneHierarchyTests covers white default, finite rejection, owner-thread reads and PackedScene; CanvasMaterialRenderingTests verifies three live parent/child/root-boundary pixel frames on Wayland compatibility/GPU and dummy software. Other platforms remain unverified.

Pinned SelfModulate multiplies only this item's drawing, not descendants. SceneHierarchyTests covers white default, finite rejection, owner-thread reads and PackedScene; CanvasMaterialRenderingTests verifies own versus descendant pixels and a live local change without re-recording on Wayland compatibility/GPU and dummy software. Other platforms remain unverified.

Pinned UseParentMaterial defaults false and selects the direct canvas parent's effective borrowed material; own material remains stored, while neutral/TopLevel/root boundaries fall back to ordinary blending. SceneHierarchyTests checks toggles, owner-thread reads, borrowing and PackedScene; CanvasMaterialRenderingTests verifies live Add/Sub/Mix pixels on Wayland compatibility/GPU. Software rejects unsupported modes explicitly; other platforms remain unverified.

NoiseTextureTests covers 2D sampling, defaults, source invalidation, gradient mapping, normals, mipmaps, seamless selection, copies, failure recovery and disposal. Generation is lazy with immediate invalidation under ADR 0013 rather than the pinned deferred worker schedule; exact derived-image parity and scene-local instantiation remain to verify. Retained Sprite pixels pass on Linux Wayland compatibility and GPU; other platforms remain unverified.
Three-dimensional noise-space sampling is outside the strict 2D product boundary (ADR 0004).

Five blend modes and the live BlendMode resource are executable on Linux Wayland GPU and compatibility hardware renderers. Software supports Mix and rejects the other modes. Light modes require the first 2D light and occlusion slice; particle animation requires 2D particle simulation and renderer integration (ADR 0028).
The five blend identities and live property are verified by resource-copy and native pixel checks on GPU and compatibility hardware. SDL software explicitly rejects modes it cannot execute correctly.
Trigger: first 2D light and occlusion renderer slice; integrate LightMode with actual light-pass selection and verify all values on both supported hardware backends (ADR 0028).
Trigger: first 2D particle simulation, material and renderer slice; wire frame counts, loop and animation enablement to particle sprite sampling (ADR 0028).
